## Summary

Describe the user-visible or developer-visible outcome.

## Verification

- [ ] Added or updated focused tests
- [ ] Ran `make check`
- [ ] Ran `make security-check` if dependencies or security boundaries changed
- [ ] Updated documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` when behavior changed

## Public data and rights

- [ ] No secrets, private URLs, account IDs, local paths, production data, real
      transcripts, source audio, voice references, embeddings, or generated
      media are included
- [ ] Any authorized media addition has the required provenance and consent
      record
- [ ] No live provider, deployment, or publication action is required to test
      this change

## Contribution license

- [ ] I agree to the Contributor License Agreement in `CLA.md`

## Notes for reviewers

Call out migrations, API changes, provider behavior, costs, security impact,
and known limitations.
